decision_question: Based on this resume alone, would I spend 45 minutes interviewing this person for this role?
verdict_rationale: No posting provided, so I judged against a typical marketing analytics intern: the survey project (R23, R24) and the weekly sales numbers (R13) fit, the internship bullets (R11, R12) describe duties.
one_line_take: For a marketing analytics internship, the survey and Excel work earn a call.
